spans.s: अक्ष् vt. 1P (pp. अक्षित) 1. To reach; 2. to pervade; 3. to accumulate.

आक्षेप m. 1. Reviling, censure, blame, विरुद्धमाक्षेपवचस्तितिक्षितम् Kir.xiv.25; 2. tossing, pulling off, throwing away, यत्रंशुकाक्षेपविलज्जितानाम् K.S.i.14, ˚गहनाक्षेपकृपणः Bhartr.iii.; 3. a deposit; 4. applying, putting in or into, गोरोचनाक्षेपनितान्तगौरे K.S.vii.17; 5. taking to itself, assuming (as the meaning of another word.), ससिद्धये पराक्षेपः K.Pr.ii.; 6. inference, जात्या व्यक्तिराक्षिप्यते K.Pr.ii.; 7. a figure of speech variously defined by various authors; (for a summary of the various definitions, See R.G. under आक्षेप).
